headline.title: AMD’s data-center revenue nearly doubles to $8.55B as MI450 systems reach customers
headline.summary: AMD’s November 3 earnings release reports $8.546 billion of Data Center revenue for the quarter ended September 26, up 97% year over year. AMD attributes growth to EPYC processors and the launch of Instinct MI450 GPUs, and says Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI and Oracle are running workloads on the first Helios systems. This is evidence of commercial momentum for another large AI infrastructure supplier, but the segment includes CPUs and other products: it is not GPU-only sales or an installed-accelerator count. AMD’s approximately $17 billion fourth-quarter outlook is company-wide guidance, rather than a reported data-center result or a guarantee of future deliveries.
